title: Megamani-fy
description:
Megamanifies the entire hud. Except menus and such
in early-early-early-early-early alpha
body:
This mod, was entirely made out of boredom. Nothing else.
i developed this mod for personal use only for myself, but i decided to upload it here. Made in 1.21.3 it might work on earlier/future versions even with warnings.
This project is in VERY, early early early early early alpha. Only the hud, inventory and golden apple hearts are done.
